newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ex-Frankfurt freight capacity to rise five percent.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Frankfurt freight capacity to rise five percent.

text.p: Cargo capacity on freighter flights departing Frankfurt airport will rise five percent this winter, airport authority Flughafen Frankfurt AG (FAG) said.
The eighteen cargo airlines operating out of Germany's cargo gateway will offer a total of 9,281 tonnes a week in airfreight capacity from October 27, an FAG statement said.
International freighter connections will rise to 234 from 220 in winter 1995-96, although the number of destinations will fall by three to 65, it added.

An FAG spokesman said that 73.6 percent of freighter flights will be operated by wide-bodied aircraft compared to 64 percent last winter and 46 percent in 1994-95. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
